review_candidates.description: Full-Stack Engineer – AI Agent Orchestration Location: Austin, Texas (on-site, 5 days per week; relocation required if necessary) Salary: $150,000–$300,000 base + 0.2–0.8% equity Working hours: Full-time, approximately 9:00 AM–9:00 PM, 6 days per week Start date: As soon as possible Work authorisation: US citizenship required Open positions: 4 Note: The primary location is listed as Austin, Texas, although San Francisco is also mentioned in the original role information. The location should be confirmed before applying. About the Company Our client is a fast-growing, Series A GovTech AI company building an AI operating system for government, powered by a substantial proprietary database of legal and regulatory information. Its AI agents help government agencies draft regulations, automate permitting processes, and streamline complex operations. The platform also supports enterprises dealing with demanding compliance requirements. The company already has live deployments across multiple state government agencies and is using AI to transform how public institutions and regulated organisations operate. About the Role We're looking for Full-Stack Engineers who approach software development through an AI-native lens. Rather than relying primarily on writing code manually, you'll orchestrate advanced AI coding agents to design, build, and ship production software at significantly accelerated speeds. The focus is on understanding how to direct, coordinate, and validate AI agents to solve complex engineering problems. You'll work across the platform, building multi-agent systems capable of sophisticated legal reasoning, developing reliable and auditable AI workflows, and contributing to both the TypeScript-based frontend and underlying AWS infrastructure. This role is ideal for engineers who combine strong software engineering fundamentals with deep knowledge of LLM capabilities, agent orchestration, and AI-assisted development. Key Responsibilities Build multi-agent systems: Design and implement agent coordination patterns for complex reasoning, legal workflows, and tool use. Develop production-ready AI pipelines: Deliver reliable, traceable, and auditable agent workflows suitable for government and legal applications. Orchestrate AI coding agents: Use advanced AI development tools to accelerate software delivery, coordinate multi-step tasks, and improve engineering productivity. Own full-stack development: Contribute across the TypeScript frontend, backend services, and AWS infrastructure. Improve user experience: Shape UI and UX features that make complex AI-powered workflows practical and accessible. Solve complex systems challenges: Apply systems thinking to agent coordination, reliability, evaluation, and production deployment. Ship at high velocity: Take ownership of features from initial concept through implementation, testing, and production release. Requirements Approximately 2–4 years of experience in a startup or high-calibre engineering team. More experienced candidates will also be considered where their background fits. Deep understanding of LLM capabilities, agent orchestration, and multi-agent architectures. Strong hands-on skills in Python and TypeScript. Excellent systems-thinking and problem-solving abilities. Extensive practical experience with AI coding agents and AI-native software development workflows. Ability to build and ship production software, rather than focusing exclusively on research or experimentation. US citizenship is required. Based in Austin, Texas, or willing to relocate immediately. Available to start as soon as possible. Ideal Background Particularly strong candidates may have: Founded or helped build an early-stage company, especially one supported by a leading startup accelerator. Worked at a high-performing startup with a strong engineering culture. Built legal AI or GovTech AI products, particularly in Austin. Contributed to open-source agent frameworks or orchestration tools. Shipped multi-step reasoning, tool-use workflows, or multi-agent systems into production. Demonstrated an exceptional ability to use AI coding agents to accelerate engineering delivery while maintaining quality and reliability. The company values engineers who are comfortable working at the frontier of AI-assisted software development and can translate emerging capabilities into robust, production-ready applications. This role is not suited to candidates who want to focus exclusively on manually writing code. Candidates whose experience is limited to large technology companies without startup or open-source contributions, consultancy backgrounds, or pure ML research without production engineering experience are unlikely to be a fit. Interview Process Founder interview focused on LLM orchestration, parallel agent coordination, and systems thinking. One- to three-day practical work trial in Austin. Offer. Why Join? Work on impactful AI: Help modernise government operations and complex regulatory workflows. Build advanced agent systems: Solve challenging problems involving multi-agent coordination, reasoning, and tool use. Develop AI-native engineering expertise: Work with coding agents as a core part of the software development process. Own end-to-end delivery: Contribute across the stack, from user interfaces to cloud infrastructure. Join a fast-growing company: Help scale a Series A business with existing government deployments. Share in the upside: Receive equity in a company building foundational technology for government and enterprise AI. If you're a highly adaptable engineer who understands how to orchestrate AI agents, thinks in systems, and wants to ship ambitious software at exceptional speed, this is an opportunity to make a meaningful impact on the future of AI-powered government.

We encourage candidates to remain vigilant of these recruiting scams and not share sensitive information if you do not believe an individual is actually affiliated with Airbnb.

review_candidates.title: Ingénieur service client itinérant H/F (basé TOURS)
review_candidates.description: As a result of the combination of the BD Biosciences and Diagnostic Solutions business with Waters Corporation (NYSE: WAT), by applying to this role, you will be applying for a position with Waters. Waters is a global leader in life sciences, dedicated to accelerating the benefits of pioneering science through analytical technologies, informatics, and service. With a focus on regulated, high-volume testing environments, Waters’ innovative portfolio harnesses deep scientific expertise across biology, chemistry, and physics. Waters collaborates with analytical laboratories around the world to advance the release of effective, high-quality medicines, assure the safety of food and water, and drive better patient outcomes by detecting diseases earlier, managing routine infections, and combatting growing antibiotic resistance. Through a shared culture of relentless innovation, Waters’ passionate team of approximately 16,000 colleagues partner with customers to turn scientific challenges into breakthroughs that improve lives worldwide. We are the people who give possibilities purpose BD is one of the largest global medical technology companies in the world. Advancing the world of health™ is our Purpose, and it’s no small feat. It takes the imagination and passion of all of us—from design and engineering to the manufacturing and marketing of our billions of MedTech products per year—to look at the impossible and find transformative solutions that turn dreams into possibilities. Job Description Vous êtes responsable du support technique auprès de nos clients durant les phases de pré et post-vente. Vous assurez l'installation, la maintenance préventive et corrective, les mises à niveau et les réparations d'instruments complexes de microbiologie et d'automatisation de laboratoire, tout en garantissant un haut niveau de satisfaction client grâce à votre expertise technique et votre réactivité. Responsabilités principales Réaliser les activités de maintenance préventive, corrective, les réparations et les mises à niveau des équipements installés chez les clients. Planifier, prioriser et exécuter les interventions conformément aux procédures BD Kiestra / IDS et aux accords de niveau de service définis. Diagnostiquer et résoudre les incidents techniques complexes, en assurant l'escalade appropriée lorsque nécessaire. Assurer la gestion et le maintien des stocks de pièces détachées, outils et équipements nécessaires à vos interventions. Former les utilisateurs et opérateurs clients à l'utilisation et à la maintenance de premier niveau des systèmes. Documenter l'ensemble des interventions et assurer le suivi des données techniques dans les systèmes de gestion afin de garantir la qualité des rapports et l'amélioration continue des performances des équipements. Profil recherché Formation Bac+2/3 minimum en électronique, informatique industrielle, automatisation, maintenance industrielle ou domaine technique équivalent. Minimum 3 ans d'expérience dans la maintenance et le dépannage d'équipements techniques complexes, idéalement dans les secteurs des dispositifs médicaux, laboratoires ou environnements réglementés. Excellentes compétences en diagnostic, résolution de problèmes et support technique sur le terrain. Forte orientation client et capacité à gérer efficacement les relations avec différentes parties prenantes. Français courant et bon niveau d'anglais professionnel, notamment pour la lecture et la rédaction de documentation technique. Permis de conduire B valide et disponibilité pour des déplacements réguliers. Atout supplémentaire : Une connaissance des techniques de microbiologie ou des environnements de laboratoire sera fortement appréciée. Why Join Us? To find purpose in the possibilities, we need people who can see the bigger picture, who understand the human story that underpins everything we do. We welcome people with the imagination and drive to help us reinvent the future of healthcare. At BD, you’ll discover a culture in which you can learn, grow and thrive. We believe that when people connect in person, we learn faster, collaborate more deeply, and build a stronger culture. Join us and enjoy a culture where face-to-face collaboration supports your learning, your progress, and your success. Becton, Dickinson, and Company is an Equal Opportunity Employer. We evaluate applicants without regard to race, color, religion, age, sex, creed, national origin, ancestry, citizenship status, marital or domestic or civil union status, familial status, affectional or sexual orientation, gender identity or expression, genetics, disability, military eligibility or veteran status, and other legally protected characteristics. review_candidates.title: DevOps Engineer
review_candidates.description: About The Company KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH, a subsidiary of the KNDS Group, has been developing specialized IT solutions for the global security and defense sectors for over 40 years at its location in Konstanz. As a comprehensive provider of complex and hardened IT systems, the company designs, develops, and implements tailored hardware and software solutions for information and communication needs. These solutions serve high-security environments and industrial sectors where reliability and security are paramount. The company's expertise spans across various domains including military communication systems, rugged hardware platforms, and monitoring and testing systems, emphasizing a system-oriented approach throughout the entire product lifecycle. Being part of the KNDS Group, KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH benefits from a robust corporate structure that fosters innovation, quality, and technological advancement. About The Role We are seeking a dedicated DevOps Engineer to join our team in Konstanz. In this role, you will be responsible for building, maintaining, and continuously improving the virtualized infrastructure that supports our software development processes within an air-gapped environment. Your expertise will facilitate seamless integration and deployment of software products, ensuring high levels of security and operational efficiency. You will collaborate closely with software development teams and IT specialists to implement and optimize CI/CD pipelines and GitOps processes, enabling rapid and reliable software delivery. Additionally, you will play a key role in implementing security measures to safeguard our systems and data, and you will be tasked with creating comprehensive technical documentation to support ongoing operations and future enhancements. Your work will directly contribute to the development of secure, reliable, and innovative solutions for critical security and defense applications. Qualifications The ideal candidate will possess a completed degree in Computer Science or a related field, or have relevant professional experience in a DevOps environment. Practical knowledge of container technologies such as Docker is essential, along with experience in Infrastructure as Code (IaC) methodologies. Proficiency with CI/CD tools and collaboration platforms, as well as version control systems, is required. You should have strong scripting skills in languages like Python and Bash, and possess solid Linux system administration knowledge. Excellent communication skills in German, both spoken and written, are necessary. We value a proactive, organized, and analytical working style, combined with creativity and the ability to work effectively within a team. Responsibilities Design, build, and maintain virtualized infrastructure environments to support software development activities within an air-gapped setting. Develop and implement CI/CD pipelines and GitOps workflows to ensure continuous integration, delivery, and deployment of software products. Collaborate closely with software development teams and IT department to integrate new software solutions and technological advancements seamlessly. Implement and oversee security protocols to protect infrastructure, systems, and data from potential threats. Create and maintain detailed technical documentation for infrastructure configurations, processes, and security measures. Monitor system performance, troubleshoot issues, and optimize infrastructure to meet evolving project requirements. Stay updated on emerging DevOps tools and best practices to continually enhance operational efficiency and security. Benefits Employment with a secure and reputable employer within the defense and security industry. Competitive salary aligned with the Bavarian IG Metall tariff agreement. Additional benefits including Christmas and holiday bonuses. Opportunities for professional development and career growth within the company. Generous vacation entitlement of 30 days annually. Convenient location with excellent public transportation connections and available employee parking. Company-sponsored retirement plan to ensure future financial security. On-site canteen providing meals and refreshments. Flexible working hours with Gleitzeit arrangements to support work-life balance. Equal Opportunity KNDS Deutschland Mission Electronics GmbH is committed to fostering an inclusive and diverse workplace. We welcome applications from individuals of all backgrounds, regardless of gender, age, ethnicity, disability, or other characteristics protected by law. Our hiring practices are based solely on merit and qualifications, and we strive to create an environment where all employees can thrive and contribute to our mission of delivering secure and innovative solutions for critical sectors.
